summary: BR Brain · Smart Paste and secure OTP accessories · credential safety fix

changes.title: Intelligent paste
changes.detail: Local destination and intent ranking with original ordinary paste.

changes.title: Verification codes and password managers
changes.detail: Masked copied-code action only in recognized OTP fields, provider-owned Autofill with stable ordering and editor-generation checks.

changes.title: Private learning and fluid chips
changes.detail: Encrypted category-only feedback, reset control and 150ms capsule geometry motion; no new permissions.

changes.title: OTP credential safety
changes.detail: Card security and verification codes, CVV/CVC and recovery credentials are excluded from automatic OTP suggestions and clipboard history. Expanded regression tests.
